title: Great show in Placa Reial
text: I attended this show with my elderly aunt and grandma. I chose this show primarily because it is a step-free venue. I’m glad we chose it! It’s right in Placa Reial and we had dinner next door after the show at Ocaña. The show was passionate and has a great singer and dancers. The dancers showed so much passion and talent. The venue wasn’t full and we were there on a Friday night. We sat near the bar, but I think any seat would be good! Great show. I recommend.
author: Angelica_B

title: Flamenco Fabuloso
text: This show was definitely the most engaging 45 minutes of my life. The show itself was magnificent and the place felt welcoming. The dancers and musicians showed their love for flamenco in their expressions. I would definitely come back for another show in the future, maybe with my friends.
author: Vivienne_G

title: The Fierce Flamenco of Los Tarantos
text:
If you want to experience true, authentic flamenco in Barcelona, Los Tarantos is an absolute must-visit! As the oldest tablao in the city (showcasing incredible artists since 1963), you can genuinely feel the history and passion the second you walk into the venue.

The entire performance was amazingly done from start to finish. The raw energy of the Spanish guitar, the soulful depth of the live singin and the sheer intensity of the dancers’ footwork left the whole room completely spellbound. title: Fantastic Performance, Poor Directions
text: The flamenco performance was beautiful and a wonderful experience, but the meeting point information was incorrect and led us around the block instead of directing us to the entrance inside the closed square.
author: Sidona_B

title: Fantastic show, amazing dancers
text:
